title: Improved homogeneous moment bound
statement:
Let $n,r,k$ be positive integers, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$ whose nonzero Fourier coefficients are all supported on sets of size $k$. Then its uniform $2r$ norm is at most
\[C_{r,k}\,\bigl(\sqrt{2r-1}\bigr)^k\,\|f\|_2,\]
where
\[C_{r,k}=\left(\frac{(rk)!}{(k!)^r r^{rk}}\right)^{1/(2r)}.\]
